title: 3 tools, zero chaos: my daily stack
caption:
3 tools I'd pick again

Most people get this wrong. Avoid these:
1️⃣ Gamma — generates a designed slide deck or one-pager from a prompt
2️⃣ Perplexity — answer engine that cites live sources — beats Google for 'what's actually true right now'
3️⃣ Claude Projects — a persistent workspace that keeps your brand voice, docs, and past work in context
